function: Learned estimation of the optimal RIS phase configuration (NN ensemble) from achievable rates measured with decision-tree-selected RIS configurations, jointly with end-to-end channel estimation (pp. 2-5).
system: Narrowband single-user MIMO uplink, source N_S=2 and destination N_D=10 antennas, reflecting passive phase-only RIS with N_I=100 elements, mmWave band, blocked direct link (pp. 3, 8).
method: Supervised decision tree choosing RIS configurations by conditional mutual information, then ensemble of supervised NNs (2 hidden layers, 20 neurons, ReLU) estimating the configuration (pp. 4-8).
data_channel: Custom single-path LoS mmWave simulator: ULA steering vectors, complex Gaussian gains, uniform angles; optimal configuration in closed form; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurement (p. 8).
test_conditions: Realizations of one single-path channel model; sweeps over SNR 0-30 dB and K=1 to 5 iterations; no unseen scenario, array size or band tested (pp. 8-10).
baselines: Benchmark: OCE on fixed configuration set; SDM codebook of [28] with OCE; single-NN OCE; perfect-CSI optimum as bound; no earlier learned method compared (pp. 8-11).
metrics: Average normalized achievable rate loss, MSE of estimated RIS configuration, mutual information, number of operations (pp. 8-10).
complexity: DTCO O=pK comparisons (13); OCE 2*sum B(l+1)B(l) operations (29); 1020 operations multiple-NN versus 10368 single-NN per RIS estimation (pp. 5, 7, 10).
q1_support: p. 8: "independent complex Gaussian variables with zero mean and unit power" in a custom single-path mmWave model (eqs. 31-32); 3GPP and NYUSIM appear only in the title of reference [40], and no standardized or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "datasets are large enough to represent the environment where the system is then deployed"; results on pp. 8-10 are sweeps over SNR and K only, with no new scenario, array size or band tested.
q3_support: p. 8: "applies the OCE on a fixed set of K RIS configurations" (benchmark is a variant of the proposed method); p. 10: SDM of [28] also feeds the same OCE; no earlier learned method is simulated.
q4_support: p. 10: "the computational complexity per RIS estimation is 1020 operations for the multiple-NN OCE and 10368 operations for single-NN OCE"; p. 5: O_DTCO = pK (13).
q5_support: p. 8: channels are simulated (eqs. 31-32 with Gaussian gains); p. 5: datasets "can be obtained by simulations or measurements in the field" only as a possibility; no code or data link or availability statement appears.
notes: The learned parts are the supervised decision tree (CMI from a simulated dataset) and the NN ensemble; channel estimation itself is least squares (p. 3), so area 3 by the main metric (rate loss and MSE of the RIS configuration). Table I read from the PDF image (p. 8). Single-antenna case only in Fig. 12 (p. 11). Benchmark and SDM reuse the proposed NN, so counted as variants for q3; the reviewer may confirm.
